about: part09 v2: open verifier notes closed with data (Lladron Gloves period bonuses, Goblin Hunting coin, Heretic rows, Crushed Faith NF wording)

entries.why: the row had half of every period bonus (Dual Wield 1, Critical Strike 2, Dex 2, Thrust 2%); the period page gives Dual Wield +3, Critical Strike +4, Dexterity 4, Thrust Resist 4% (bonus types 28/23/2/19 unchanged; Level 13, AF 76, ABS 10 already match the page)
entries.source: Allakhazam item citem=5127 'Lladron Gloves' (Wayback capture 2003-08-26, period-data/archive/wayback-allakhazam/period_items.jsonl.gz): Leather hands, AF 76, Absorb 10, Dexterity 4 pts, Critical Strikes +4 pts, Dual Wield +3 pts, Thrust Resist 4%, Level to Attain 13, from Spirits of the Orchard

entries.why: Goblin Hunting paid no coin; the period head says 'Grants Coin: Yes' and two players on the period page report 2 silver at the turn-in ('I got some XP and 2 silver pcs', 'All I have to show for the effort is 2sp'), so the finish step pays 2 silver (200 copper)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 47 'Goblin Hunting' (Wayback capture 2004-10-14, quest_pages.jsonl.gz), player comments of 2001-2003

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, 'Kill Dash, who appears at night south of Caer Boldiam tower 3 by the grimwoods and cockatrices.', 'Kill Dash, who appears only at night in the Pennine Mountains.') WHERE ID = 21370
entries.why: the journal sent players to 'Caer Boldiam tower 3', a New Frontiers tower (towers do not exist in the 1.65 old frontiers); the 2004 period page says only 'Dash (loc=4k, 12k, only spawns at night) ... in Pennine Mountains', which matches the existing spawn and marker at Pennine 5737,9927 (the 21418,11817 loc is from the post-NF page)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 273 'Crushed Faith' (Wayback capture 2004-10-14): '6)Finally he will tell you that it is Dash (loc=4k, 12k, only spawns at night.) you need to kill in Pennine Mountains'; 2002 comment 'Found Dash in Penn. Mtns 4k, 12k'
